meta.format: R6 M1 combo, keyframes + every baked 60 fps frame
meta.rig: R6, default proportions: Torso 2x2x1, Head 2x1x1, arms/legs 1x2x1; HRP centre is 3 studs above the floor
meta.axes_hrp_frame: +X = character's right, +Y = up, -Z = forward (toward the target). Positions are studs relative to the HumanoidRootPart at frame 0.
meta.joint_rotation_convention: joints[J].euler_xyz_deg = [x, y, z] degrees applied as Rx(x)*Ry(y)*Rz(z) (Roblox CFrame.Angles order: Z first, then Y, then X), expressed in TORSO space and applied about the joint pivot by pre-multiplying the Motor6D's C0 rotation:  C0' = CFrame.new(C0.Position) * CFrame.Angles(x,y,z) * C0.Rotation  (this is exactly what src/ReplicatedStorage/Combat/Poses.lua does). Zero everywhere = default R6 rest pose.
meta.motor6d_transform: joints[J].transform_quat_xyzw / transform_euler_xyz_deg / transform_pos is the SAME pose expressed as a Motor6D.Transform (what an AnimationTrack / KeyframeSequence Pose stores): Part1 = Part0 * C0 * Transform * C1:Inverse(). transform_quat_xyzw is order-agnostic: CFrame.new(px,py,pz, qx,qy,qz,qw). Only the Root joint has a translation (transform_pos, in RootJoint space); it is how the torso sits relative to the HumanoidRootPart (torso_offset_hrp, in HRP axes).
meta.interpolation: Between keyframes: quaternion slerp of each joint with the easing named on the ARRIVING keyframe (ease_arriving); torso offset is lerped with the same alpha. baked_frames is exactly that, evaluated on every integer frame.
meta.code_lunge: Config.M1.Lunge for Config.M1.LungeTime is applied by the game as physics at swing start. It is NOT animated; baked frames only report it (code_lunge_forward) so reach can be checked. The HumanoidRootPart must not be moved by the animation.
meta.foot_planting: Planted feet are solved with IK to fixed floor footprints; torso_offset_hrp.y already contains the stance height. Joint values therefore already include the leg IK; just play the joint data.
meta.dummy: The storyboard target is a pale R6 dummy whose chest front face is 4.6 studs in front of the start position (Z = -4.6); contact_vs_dummy_z in validation is the strike marker's Z minus that face (0 = touching, negative = through it).
meta.timing_source: contact_frame 7 = Config.M1.Windup (0.11s) at 60 fps; M1_1..M1_3 are 20 frames (Config.M1.SwingCooldown 0.32s); the finisher is 51 frames (Config.M1.EndLag 0.85s).
meta.markers: RightFist/LeftFist = centre of the arm's free end, RightFoot/LeftFoot = centre of the leg's free end, in world studs relative to the start HRP, including code_lunge_forward.

attacks.name: Right Straight
attacks.summary: Rear-hand cross: hips fire first, shoulder follows, fist last

keyframes.name: Ready
keyframes.note: Guard stance, bladed: left shoulder forward, chin tucked, both hands up.

keyframes.name: Load
keyframes.note: Rear hand drops back to the hip, torso coils right, weight sinks onto the back leg. Lead hand rises to cover the chin.

keyframes.name: Fire
keyframes.note: Hips fire first (torso already unwound), shoulder follows, fist accelerates through the middle of the path.
cues: vfx: motion trail starts at the fist

keyframes.name: CONTACT
keyframes.note: Arm fully extended at chest height, slightly crossing the centreline. Chest squared through the target, rear foot pivoted forward, lead hand tight at the chin.
cues: vfx: hit spark at the fist
hitstop: hold this pose 3 frames (0.05s) on a confirmed hit

keyframes.name: Follow-through
keyframes.note: Small overshoot, body commits forward over the lead leg.

keyframes.name: Retract
keyframes.note: Fist snaps back to the chin, hips unwind back toward the stance.

keyframes.name: Ready
keyframes.note: Back in guard. This is where M1_2 can begin (swing cooldown 0.32s = frame 19).

attacks.name: Left Hook
attacks.summary: Lead-hand hook: torso turns the arm like a gate, arc ends across the body

keyframes.name: Ready
keyframes.note: Guard stance, bladed: left shoulder forward, chin tucked, both hands up.

keyframes.name: Load
keyframes.note: Torso twists left (left shoulder pulled back), left arm cocks out to the side at shoulder height, slightly behind the body. Rear hand guards the chin.

keyframes.name: Fire
keyframes.note: Torso drives right; the arm is still out wide and just now swinging forward.
cues: vfx: motion trail starts at the fist

keyframes.name: CONTACT
keyframes.note: Whole torso has turned right; the straight arm sweeps across the front at head-to-chest height and meets the target on the centreline. Elbow-out hook shape comes from the arm being horizontal.
cues: vfx: hit spark at the fist
hitstop: hold this pose 3 frames (0.05s) on a confirmed hit

keyframes.name: Follow-through
keyframes.note: Arm carries on across the body, shoulders turned away; head still tracks the target.

keyframes.name: Retract
keyframes.note: Arm folds back to the guard line, torso unwinding.

keyframes.name: Ready
keyframes.note: Back in guard. M1_3 can begin here.

attacks.name: Right Overhand
attacks.summary: Looping rear-hand chop: arm travels up and over, torso dives with it

keyframes.name: Ready
keyframes.note: Guard stance, bladed: left shoulder forward, chin tucked, both hands up.

keyframes.name: Load
keyframes.note: Right shoulder dips and tucks back, right arm swings up and behind the head. Weight loads onto the rear leg.

keyframes.name: Fire
keyframes.note: Arm is vertical over the shoulder at the top of the loop while the torso rotates through.
cues: vfx: motion trail starts at the fist

keyframes.name: CONTACT
keyframes.note: Torso has dived forward and turned; the arm has come down over the top and meets the target ahead of the chest. Heaviest lean of the three punches.
cues: vfx: hit spark at the fist
hitstop: hold this pose 3 frames (0.05s) on a confirmed hit

keyframes.name: Follow-through
keyframes.note: Fist continues down and across toward the left hip, head still up on the target.

keyframes.name: Recover
keyframes.note: Torso rises and unwinds, arm returns to guard.

keyframes.name: Ready
keyframes.note: Back in guard. M1_4 (finisher) can begin here.

attacks.name: Roundhouse Finisher
attacks.summary: Grounded finisher: coil, chamber, whip the right leg across the target; long recovery (0.85s)

keyframes.name: Ready
keyframes.note: Guard stance, bladed: left shoulder forward, chin tucked, both hands up.

keyframes.name: Chamber
keyframes.note: Torso coils hard right, weight onto the left (planted) leg, right leg lifts out to the side and slightly behind, knee-high.

keyframes.name: Whip
keyframes.note: Hips and torso unwind explosively; the leg is already sweeping forward at hip height.
cues: vfx: arc trail starts at the foot

keyframes.name: CONTACT
keyframes.note: Leg is straight and horizontal, pointing at the target; torso leans back and away to counterbalance, right arm flung wide.
cues: vfx: hit spark + shockwave ring at the foot
hitstop: hold this pose 4 frames (0.07s) on a confirmed hit

keyframes.name: Follow-through
keyframes.note: Leg keeps travelling across the body, torso fully rotated.

keyframes.name: Hang
keyframes.note: Brief held overextension (finisher lands heavy, attacker is committed).
cues: recovery: no cancel into other actions

keyframes.name: Retract
keyframes.note: Leg pulls back, torso starts to square up.

keyframes.name: Set down
keyframes.note: Right foot is coming back toward the floor.

keyframes.name: Ready
keyframes.note: Planted again in guard. End lag over (Config.M1.EndLag = 0.85s).
